title: 雨降り茶屋と潮風の灯台
author: 藤堂 小太郎

en.title: The Rainy Day Tea House and the Sea-Breeze Lighthouse
en.premise: In a mysterious tea house that quietly opens its doors only on rainy days, the meddlesome residents of a local tenement house gather. One day, they discover the existence of a grumpy yet lonely old man living all alone in an ancient lighthouse on the outskirts of town. A heartwarming tale where people's hearts begin to thaw, much like the sky after a rainfall.

zh.title: 细雨茶屋与海风灯塔
zh.premise: 在一家只在雨天悄然挂起帘幕的神奇茶屋里，爱管闲事的长屋居民们聚集于此。有一天，他们得知了一位住在城郊破旧灯塔里的老人——他性格古怪，却又内心孤独。这是一个如雨后晴空般，让人们的心灵逐渐释然、温暖治愈的故事。
